title: Extract session hydration lifecycle from useAppLiveState
outcome: Current-tree audit 2026-09-22: ui/src/app-live-state.ts is 1,794 lines. useAppLiveState mixes broad state adoption with per-session hydration admission, queued tail repairs, retry timers, partial-tail proof tracking, request context capture, stale-response handling and startSessionHydration. Extract the hydration lifecycle into a focused controller/hook with explicit state ownership and narrow dependencies, retaining app-level orchestration and SSE event handling in their existing modules. Coordinate with active tm-kei8 (hydration bursts), tm-moao (send-response duplicate prompt), and tm-7cu.44 (activation viewport) before changing shared code; land this separately from those correctness fixes.
acceptance: No change to hydration concurrency/deduplication, retry timing, mutation/revision adoption, partial-tail proofs, queued-after-current semantics, session deletion cleanup or unmount cancellation. Keep one owner for refs/timers instead of copying state into two controllers. Move focused tests and preserve integration coverage; no weakened checks or timer inflation. Ownership header and maintained-launcher validation required.
